description: Source code for the 'channels/api4' package handling bot-related API endpoints in Mattermost, including creating, updating, retrieving, enabling/disabling, assigning, and converting bots to users.

classes.name: API
classes.description: Main API handler struct for bot-related endpoints.

methods.name: InitBot
methods.description: Initializes bot-related API routes and handlers.

methods.name: createBot
methods.description: Handles creation of a new bot.

methods.name: getBot
methods.description: Retrieves a specific bot by ID.

methods.name: updateBotActive
methods.description: Updates the active status of a bot.

methods.name: assignBot
methods.description: Assigns a bot to a user.

methods.name: convertBotToUser
methods.description: Converts a bot into a user account.
